label: normal
title: Real grandson checking in (hard negative: says 'Grandma, it's me')

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Ethan! Oh, what a nice surprise. How are you, sweetheart?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'm good. Classes are busy, but I finally finished my big project this week.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Oh, I'm so proud of you. Are you eating enough up there?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am, I promise. Mom keeps sending me those frozen lasagnas.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Good. Your mother always did make the best lasagna.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: So I was thinking, I'm coming home for Thanksgiving. Can I bring my roommate, Jake? His family is too far away.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Of course you can. The more the merrier. Does he like pumpkin pie?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: He loves it. I told him yours is the best in the state.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Well, now I have to make two of them.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ha, perfect. Alright Grandma, I have to run to class. I'll call you on Sunday like always.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay honey. I love you. Drive safe when you come home.
